title: Full UI rebuild with Tailwind and GitHub full-system UAT expansion
businessRules: Presentation and information architecture are being rebuilt, not patched; existing backend/API business authority remains unchanged.
Admin must use exactly one primary navigation plus at most one contextual secondary navigation layer; redundant workspace rails/decks/context strips are forbidden.
Every implemented operator capability must have a discoverable UI home, including tenant/organization, Telegram/WhatsApp, AI/forecasting, reports, automation, users/roles, and settings/security.
Admin, POS, Storefront, and Employee Portal use Tailwind CSS v4 with one visual language, Lucide icons, responsive no-horizontal-page-overflow behavior, and progressive disclosure.
GitHub UAT remains fail-closed and continues to test exact artifacts, PostgreSQL runtime, API/provider flows, browser geometry, worker/reporting, staging, load/index, DR, and automated Stage-20.
Human UAT remains separate and blocked until visual acceptance of the rebuilt UI.

R0 deep-audit recovery supersedes visual-only completion: final F12R4 verification cannot resume until R1-R6 operator-function gaps required by the 48/48 matrix are resolved or explicitly reclassified.
acceptanceCriteria: Legacy accumulated UI overrides are replaced rather than appended; all four app globals are Tailwind v4 canonical stylesheets.

Admin information architecture explicitly exposes sales/orders, procurement, inventory, master data, finance, reporting, HR/payroll, assets/fleet, AI/automation, integrations/notifications, tenant/organization, and settings/access.
Telegram/WhatsApp provider configuration is reachable from an explicit Integrations & Notifications workspace; AI is reachable from an explicit AI & Automation workspace.
Admin shell contains one sidebar, one contextual subnav, and one content surface without duplicate navigation layers.
POS sale/cart hierarchy is optimized for high mobility and collapses cleanly at tablet/mobile without page horizontal scrolling.
Storefront and Employee Portal use the same restrained flat visual system and fit supported viewports without page horizontal scrolling.
Existing business regression remains green and the expanded GitHub UAT gates are preserved or strengthened, never skipped.
Recovery matrix prerequisites for operator-facing functionality are closed before F12R4 can return to VERIFICATION.
testPlan: Run source audits for all UI routes/navigation/API references and forbidden visual anti-patterns.
Run sync idempotency/retry/conflict regression unchanged because provider/device/offline navigation remains in scope.
Run local candidate gate for TypeScript, SQLite DB smoke, and six-app build.
Run GitHub Full System Simulation with API sweep, provider simulation, browser desktop/tablet/mobile geometry, worker/report, staging/load/index/DR, and automated Stage-20.
Human Stage-20 remains blocked until visual acceptance.
migrationPlan: No database schema change is planned. Tailwind/PostCSS and CI/UAT changes are source/build tooling only; existing expand-only database migration chain remains unchanged and must still be rehearsed.
rollbackPlan: Revert this work item commit set to the last source-bound automated-GitHub-PASS commit. No database rollback is required because schema is unchanged. If the new UAT gate itself is defective, fix the gate while preserving or strengthening its assertions; never bypass it to release.
monitoringPlan: GitHub job summary and uploaded source-bound evidence will report API coverage, browser viewport coverage, provider simulation results, exact artifact identity, worker/report probe, staging/load/index/DR and Stage-20 automated state. UI regressions are additionally checked by local candidate gate before push.
securityNotes: All runtime identity continues to come from authenticated server context. CI uses non-production PostgreSQL and synthetic provider endpoints. GitHub secrets/environment secrets are never echoed, browser/localStorage evidence is sanitized, provider mocks validate headers/payloads without storing real tokens, and Human Stage-20 remains separately approved.
